description: An export (actions_audit rows, as onedoor.export.write_export would write them) and five decision references, each engineered to give exactly one of onedoor.decision_ref.check's five outcomes against that SAME export: matches, digest_mismatch (same request_id, wrong digest), not_in_export (a request_id no row carries), malformed_ref (missing required fields), and export_damaged (a property of the FILE, not any one row -- demonstrated by corrupting a byte of the export text or its .sha256 sidecar, not representable as a vector row; see onedoor.decision_ref.check_files).

export_rows.evaluation_trace_json: [{"check":"kill_switch","rule":"an engaged kill switch requires human approval for anything but an exempt read","condition":"engaged == false","value":"false","result":"pass"},{"check":"default_deny","rule":"an action type must be declared to a policy to auto-execute or be proposed","condition":"policy.is_default_deny == false","value":"vectors.simple","result":"pass"},{"check":"effect_floor","rule":"an action inherits the strictest tier floor of its resolved effects","condition":"no resolved effect's min_tier exceeds the nominal tier","value":"none","result":"pass"},{"check":"opaque_host","rule":"a declared opaque host class can never resolve to auto-execution; a human decides","condition":"opaque_class is None, already overridden, or the request is exempt","value":"none","result":"pass"},{"check":"reversibility","rule":"an auto-executing tier requires a registered compensating command","condition":"effective_tier not in (auto, auto_capped) or a compensating_command is set","value":"vectors.reverse","result":"pass"},{"check":"bounds","rule":"declared parameter bounds (numeric ranges, enum membership, required keys) must be satisfied","condition":"bounds.validate(policy.bounds, request.params).ok","value":"within bounds","result":"pass"},{"check":"dry_run","rule":"a policy in dry-run rehearses rather than executes","condition":"not dry_run and (dry_run_until is None or now >= dry_run_until)","value":"live","result":"pass"},{"check":"caps","rule":"budget caps (rate and/or value) must not be exceeded by this action","condition":"already-reserved + this action's cost <= every declared cap","value":"within caps","result":"pass"}]

cases.note: corrupt the export file or its .sha256 sidecar; see check_files
